title.zh: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
title.en: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks

current_state.zh: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs and four other companies joined the list of issuers objecting to their shares being traded on the planned OKX-Intercontinental Exchange tokenized stock venue, raising the total to 16, while the venue said it may also list stocks tokenized by issuers themselves.
